```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>",
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5)
```

```{r setup}
library(ProjetJuliaR)

# Mêmes plis de validation croisée pour tous les modèles (et pour Julia)
folds <- make_folds(nrow(coimbra), k = 5, seed = 123)
```

## Données

- **Classification** : `coimbra`, cible `Classification` (sain / cancer).
- **Régression** : `coimbra_reg`, cible `logLeptin` (log du taux de leptine).

```{r}
table(coimbra$Classification)
summary(coimbra_reg$logLeptin)
```

# I. Arbre de décision

## I.1 Approche classification

```{r}
set.seed(123)
tree_c <- fit_tree(coimbra, "Classification")
plot_tree(tree_c)
```

```{r}
cv_tree_c <- cross_validate(coimbra, "Classification", fit_tree, folds)
cv_tree_c
colMeans(cv_tree_c)
```

## I.2 Approche régression

```{r}
set.seed(123)
tree_r <- fit_tree(coimbra_reg, "logLeptin")
plot_tree(tree_r)
```

```{r}
cv_tree_r <- cross_validate(coimbra_reg, "logLeptin", fit_tree, folds)
cv_tree_r
colMeans(cv_tree_r)
```

# II. Forêt aléatoire

## II.1 Approche classification

Choix de `mtry` (nombre de variables tirées à chaque nœud) :

```{r}
tune_c <- tune_forest(coimbra, "Classification", mtry_values = 1:9, folds = folds)
tune_c
mtry_c <- tune_c$mtry[which.max(tune_c$score)]   # AUC la plus haute
mtry_c
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
rf_c <- fit_forest(coimbra, "Classification", mtry = mtry_c)
rf_c
randomForest::varImpPlot(rf_c, main = "Importance des variables (classification)")
```

## II.2 Approche régression

```{r}
tune_r <- tune_forest(coimbra_reg, "logLeptin", mtry_values = 1:7, folds = folds)
tune_r
mtry_r <- tune_r$mtry[which.min(tune_r$score)]   # RMSE la plus basse
mtry_r
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
rf_r <- fit_forest(coimbra_reg, "logLeptin", mtry = mtry_r)
rf_r
randomForest::varImpPlot(rf_r, main = "Importance des variables (régression)")
```

# III. Comparaison arbre / forêt

Moyenne +/- écart-type sur les 5 plis.

```{r}
knitr::kable(compare_models(coimbra, "Classification", folds, mtry = mtry_c),
             caption = "Classification (sain / cancer)")
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(compare_models(coimbra_reg, "logLeptin", folds, mtry = mtry_r),
             caption = "Régression (log de la leptine)")
```
